articles.headline: The Dates That Matter Most For Verizon Stock
articles.summary: Verizon Communications (VZ) shares have lost 6.8%, dividends included, since September 18, 2026. The S&P 500 gained 0.6% over the same period. articles.headline: Aduna and Major U.S. Carriers Expand Network API Portfolio to Help Businesses Combat Fraud
articles.summary: Aduna, a leading global aggregator of standardised network APIs, today announced three powerful fraud prevention APIs across the United States: Know Your Customer, Device Swap, and Call Forward Detection, targeted for availability in Q4. articles.headline: Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines expand global network with new nonstop service connecting Seattle with Osaka and Papeete
articles.summary: Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines are broadening its global network with new year-round, nonstop service between Seattle and Osaka, Japan, and Papeete, Tahiti, French Polynesia, bringing two new international destinations within easy reach of guests across the continental U.S.
